Anurag Vishwakarma · Founder

About

Studio jo phone bhi uthata hai.

Sagar Web Studio Sagar, Madhya Pradesh se chalta hai. Seedhi baat: yahan acchi bakery, gym, mithai shop, restaurant aur clinic ke customer hain — lekin Google pe search karo to site ya to nahi milti, ya purani padti hai.

Main inhi local businesses ke liye website banata hoon. Jo shop already chal rahi hai, use online bhi utna hi sahi dikhna chahiye. Lamba “discovery phase” nahi. Template ko strategy nahi bolte.

Main Anurag hoon. Baat Hindi-English dono mein hoti hai. Preview phone pe dikhata hoon. Agar site tumhari shop jaisi na lage, tab tak badalta hoon jab tak lage. Milna ho to Sagar mein mil jaate hain — warna poora kaam WhatsApp pe bhi ho sakta hai.

FAQ

Sawaal jo shop owners sabse pehle poochte hain.

Aapko mujhse kya chahiye?

Shop ka naam, 8–12 photos, menu ya price list, WhatsApp number, aur customer se kya karwana hai — call, order, ya booking.

Price me kya nahi hai?

Domain, saalana hosting, package limit ke baad extra revisions, aur paid ads. Tax extra hai (agar applicable ho).

Kitna time lagega?

Basic 7 din. WhatsApp Ordering 10 din. Premium 14 din. Time tab se ginenge jab humein photos aur menu mil jaayein.

Kitne changes maang sakta hoon?

Basic 2 rounds, WhatsApp Ordering 3 rounds, Premium 4 rounds. Launch ke baad, Standard me 1 mahine ke chhote tweaks aur Premium me 3 mahine ka support shaamil hai.

Kya website meri hogi?

Haan. Files aapki hongi. Hum site ko apni hosting ke peeche lock nahi karte.

Kya Sagar me mil sakte hain?

Haan. Anurag ko WhatsApp pe message karein. Hum aamne-saamne mil sakte hain, ya poora project WhatsApp pe bhi ho sakta hai.

Mere paas Instagram hai — website kyun?

Instagram scroll karne ke liye hai. Website wo jagah hai jaha timing, menu, location, aur WhatsApp ordering ek saath rehte hain — jo customer kabhi bhi dhundh sake.

Paise kab dene hain?

Do options hain — 50% advance dekar design shuru karwaiye, baaki site live hone se pehle. Ya chahen to poora payment site poori taiyar hone ke baad bhi kar sakte hain — jo aapko sahi lage.
